events.title: Annual Veterans Day Celebration
events.summary: Join us for Carefree's 17th Annual Veterans Day Celebration!
events.description:
Join us for Carefree's 17th Annual Veterans Day Celebration!

Come enjoy a special afternoon honoring the courage, sacrifice, and service of our nation's veterans. This cherished community tradition brings us together through inspiring stories, patriotic music, and heartfelt tributes.

• 📅 Wednesday, November 11, 2026

• ⏰ 3–5 p.m.

• 📍 Sanderson Lincoln Pavilion, Carefree

• 🎟️ Free & Open to the Public

• 🎖️ Event Highlights:

Keynote Speaker: Master Sgt. Scott Ford (Retired), U.S. Army Green Beret and Silver Star recipient

Special Remarks: Chief Master Sgt. Chuck Lee (Retired), U.S. Air Force

Honoring Veterans' Legacies: Local youth from Imprints of Honor

Live Patriotic Music: Ava Cohen and the Main Event Swing Band

A Moving Tribute: Military service hymns and a solemn performance of "The Last Post" and "Taps"

❤️🤍💙 Come together as a community to show your gratitude, celebrate our veterans, and honor the generations who have served to protect our freedoms.

🔗 Learn more: www.visitcarefree.com/veterans

events.summary: December 4 th , 2026 4PM – 6PM! Live Music: TBD SAC Ceramics Department:  Demos and Ceramics Sale Exhibition Opening:  Holiday Market Celebrate Sedona engages…
events.description:
December 4th, 2026 4PM – 6PM!

• Live Music: TBD
• SAC Ceramics Department: Demos and Ceramics Sale
• Exhibition Opening: Holiday Market

Celebrate Sedona engages the local community while celebrating and featuring local and regional arts, food and drink! Held in the upper parking lot of Sedona Arts Center, Celebrate Sedona is a monthly celebration of the beauty and diversity of our community’s music, food, drink, and artistry..

Holiday Market

December 4th – December 6th, 2026

This festive exhibit brings together up to 40 talented artists from across the region, each offering a unique selection of work specially curated for the holiday season. Showcasing a wide variety of mediums—including painting, ceramics, jewelry, fiber art, book arts, photography, glass, woodwork, and mixed media—this annual event is a celebration of creativity, craftsmanship, and community spirit. Whether you’re looking for a one-of-a-kind gift or a special piece to add to your own collection, the exhibit offers something for everyone, with works that range from elegant and refined to playful and whimsical. Visitors can enjoy browsing an inspiring array of locally made art while supporting regional artists and makers during this meaningful time of year. Perfect for holiday shopping or simply soaking in the season’s creative energy, the exhibit is a joyful expression of artistic talent and the beauty of giving.

Vision and Sound: An African American Experience

Buckeye, Goodyear, Peoria, Sedona and Tolleson: January – March 2027

Sedona Exhibit: January 15 – February 28, 2027

Originally founded by Norma and Michael Cunningham in the West Valley of Phoenix, this visionary program was created to uplift and showcase the work of notable African-American artists from across Arizona, spanning a wide range of artistic genres and voices. In 2022, the program found a vibrant new home at Sedona Arts Center, where it has continued to grow into a dynamic and inclusive annual exhibition. Celebrating the creativity, resilience, and cultural contributions of African-American artists, the exhibit offers a platform for both established and emerging talent, fostering deeper understanding and appreciation through visual art, performance, and dialogue.

In 2020, a meaningful partnership was established with the ASU Center for the Study of Race & Democracy, adding academic depth and critical engagement to the program. This collaboration has since expanded to include an annual…

gemini.wanted:
What this person wants: community happenings in the Phoenix area. Night markets and pop-up or
holiday markets; cultural festivals and heritage celebrations (Lunar New Year, Diwali, Día de
Muertos, Chuseok, Obon and the like); street fairs, block parties and parades; seasonal and holiday
events (harvest festivals, pumpkin patches, tree lightings, holiday lights); food and drink
festivals; art walks and art fairs; free outdoor concerts and outdoor movies; farmers markets.
Leave out: ticketed concerts and tours, sports games and watch parties, theater, comedy and dance
performances, bar and club nights, pub crawls, classes, workshops and lectures, conferences and
expos, galas, auctions and fundraising dinners, meetups and support groups, services such as food
banks and clinics, museum exhibitions, restaurant deals and business promotions, and anything sold
through resale ticket sites. A price doesn't decide it: farm harvest festivals, pumpkin patches,
fairs and food festivals often charge admission and are still wanted. Anything that is one of the
kinds above is wanted; when unsure, leave it out.
Categories: NIGHT_MARKET (night, pop-up, holiday and craft markets), CULTURAL (cultural and heritage
festivals), COMMUNITY (street fairs, block parties, parades, general community festivals), SEASONAL
(harvest, Halloween, winter holiday and other seasonal events), FOOD (food and drink festivals), ARTS
(art walks, art fairs), OUTDOOR (free outdoor concerts and movies), FARMERS (farmers markets).
gemini.summaryRule: summary: one plain sentence of at most 20 words saying what happens there. No hype words (amazing, don't miss, must-see), no dates, no prices.
